Subject: Correction: North account moves

From: Ilse Varga  
To: Dana Okafor; Marcus Lindqvist  
Date: 2025-10-03

Dana, Marcus,

Please treat this message as the correction to my October 1 email below. I named the wrong account in the transfer instruction.

**Tamsin Cold Chain stays with Dana Okafor. Orrin Mills is the account moving to Marcus Lindqvist on 2025-10-06.**

The effective date was correct; the account name was not. Please do not interpret the earlier message as a separate instruction to move Tamsin Cold Chain. There is one move being described in this thread, and it is Orrin Mills.

For clarity, the position as of today, Oct. 3, is:

- Tamsin Cold Chain remains with Dana Okafor.
- Orrin Mills is currently managed by Dana Okafor.
- Orrin Mills moves to Marcus Lindqvist on October 6.

I apologize for the confusion. The error was in my original email, not in anyone's reading of it. I should have checked the account name against the intended handoff before sending.

Please use this correction when preparing the handoff notes. If the earlier instruction has already been copied into a working list or an internal note, please amend that entry rather than leaving both versions without an explanation. A short reference back to this email should be sufficent; there is no need to reproduce the entire thread.

For any draft communication that relies on the account assignment, please check the account name before it goes out. The correction concerns the assignment only; this thread should not be used as the basis for unrelated changes.

I would also appreciate a brief ack from each of you so I know the corrected instruction has been recieved. If anything in the working notes still points to Tamsin Cold Chain moving on Monday, please flag it here so we can clear up the wording in one place.

Thank you for your patience, and apologies again for the unnecessary checking this creates.

Ilse Varga  
North team lead  
Pemberline Systems
